cells.gaps: The Schéma stratégique intégré's period ended in 2024 and no row shows a successor sector policy adopted or in preparation. The Politique nationale de développement des TIC is named by the minister in July 2025 (DJI-001) with no adoption date, standing, period or text, so it cannot be staged; that fact also falls outside the twelve months. The approving law names an action plan and gives no dated actions or cost, and the commission and ministry unit it creates date from 2015, outside the 36 months. No text, report or finance has been found for the SSI.
cells.note: Schéma stratégique intégré (SSI) 2014-2024: approved by Law 80/AN/14, published 25 February 2015, for the ten years 2014 to 2024, replacing the 2003-2013 strategy, so it is the newest adopted sector policy and expired before the as-at with no successor sector policy in preparation. An expired policy places nothing; a national digital strategy is held, which is noted and does not place the country.
